login.intro: Sign in to ask questions about the organisation's documents.
login.guestHint: Guests can explore the sample documents only.

ask.title: Ask a question
ask.body: Ask about the organisation's documents and get answers with their sources. This screen is being built.

library.title: Library
library.body: Browse and search every document in the archive. This screen is being built.

upload.title: Upload documents
upload.body: Add PDF, Word and text files to the library. This screen is being built.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: Manage users and review how the assistant is used. This screen is being built.

document.title: Document
document.body: The document viewer is being built.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to Ask.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.body: Ask an administrator if you need it.

form.label: Your question
form.placeholder: Ask about the documents, in Arabic or English
form.hint: Press Enter to send. Shift+Enter adds a new line.

stage.queued: Waiting for the assistant to be free…

wait.overrun: Still working, taking longer than usual ({{elapsed}} so far).
wait.busy: The server is busy right now, so this answer may take several minutes.

refusal.gate: The documents don't cover this question.
refusal.read: Some passages were read, but nothing usable was found in them.

citations.heading: Sources
citations.convertedWord: The page number refers to the converted PDF and may differ from Word.
citations.convertedOther: The page number refers to the converted PDF and may differ from the original file.

history.heading: Your questions
history.guestHint: As a guest, you see only the questions asked in this session.

admin.intro: Manage who can sign in and what each person can do. Accounts are never deleted: deactivate them instead.

create.heading: New user
create.missingFields: Enter a name, an email address and a password.

edit.label: Edit {{name}}
edit.selfHint: You can't change your own role or deactivate your own account.
edit.guestHint: The guest account is always a viewer. Its role can't be changed.
edit.confirmBody: The person will be signed out everywhere and can't sign in again until an administrator reactivates the account.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are not valid. Review them and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again later.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been deactivated. Ask an administrator to reactivate it.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least {{min_length}} characters long.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ACCESS: You can't remove your own administrator access or deactivate your own account.
errors.GUEST_ROLE_FIXED: The guest account is always read-only; its role can't be changed.
errors.DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT: This file has already been uploaded.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the upload limit.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This file type is not supported. Upload a PDF, Word (DOCX) or plain-text (TXT) file.
errors.FILE_CORRUPT: The file is damaged and cannot be read.
errors.PDF_ENCRYPTED: The PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
errors.NO_TEXT_LAYER: This file has no text layer (scanned image). Scanned documents cannot be searched yet.
errors.CONVERSION_FAILED: The file could not be converted to PDF for viewing.
errors.TXT_ENCODING_UNKNOWN: The text file's character encoding could not be recognised. Save it as UTF-8 and upload it again.
errors.WORKER_TIMEOUT: Processing stopped before it finished. Use Retry to process the file again.
errors.ML_UNAVAILABLE: The indexing service is not available. Use Retry to process the file again.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: This document is still being processed.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only a document that failed can be retried.
errors.SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE: Searching the documents is not possible right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The answer service is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.HOSTED_LLM_NON_SEED_DATA: This server is set up to send excerpts to an external AI service, which is only allowed for the sample documents. No question was sent. Ask an administrator.

answer.refusal: I couldn't find an answer to this in the available documents.
answer.lowConfidence: This answer is based on sources that may not fully match your question. Check them before relying on it.

documents.restrictedHint: Visible to editors and admins only

library.intro: Every document you have access to. Select a row to open the document.

search.label: Search titles
search.placeholder: Search by title, in Arabic or English

library.empty: There are no documents in the library yet.

edit.heading: Edit document details
edit.title: Title
edit.yearHint: Four digits, for example 2021. Leave it empty if the year is unknown.
edit.yearInvalid: Enter a year from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave it empty.

upload.intro: Add PDF, Word (DOCX) and text (TXT) files. Each file is uploaded and processed on its own, so one bad file never stops the others.

details.hint: These apply to every file you add next. Each title is taken from its file name, and you can change any detail later in the Library.
details.restricted: Restricted: visible to editors and admins only

drop.label: Drag files here, or choose them from your computer.
drop.hint: PDF, DOCX or TXT. You can add several files at once.
drop.active: Drop the files to upload them.

viewer.convertedWord: This PDF was converted from a Word file. Page numbers refer to the converted PDF and may differ from Word.
viewer.convertedOther: This PDF was converted from the original file. Page numbers refer to the converted PDF and may differ from the original.
viewer.notReady: This document is still being processed. It can be opened once it is ready.
viewer.failed: This document could not be processed.
viewer.renderFailed: The document could not be displayed.
